title: [Peek] Add preview support for EML and MSG email files

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The linked-source parser harness remains unexecuted. Standard Git materialization passed exact-head and source/fixture hash checks after an earlier archive extraction failed. A baseline build then stopped on missing restore assets. The latest explicit-restore attempt did not execute its target: a launcher parameter collided with a PowerShell automatic variable, so the child received no arguments and emitted only its interactive banner and prompt. Its zero exit code was rejected as restore evidence. The corrected private launcher passed a harmless Windows PowerShell 5.1 sentinel that verified working directory, argument boundaries, and propagation of a distinct exit code. No restore or build was retried; assets, baseline and candidate builds, test discovery, tests, and TRX generation remain unverified or unrun.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
